visual_enhancers.surfaces: Retro-Futurism / Grid Borders: Use 1px borders with border-slate-800. Cards should have no shadow but a subtle inner glow on hover.
visual_enhancers.glassmorphism: For sticky headers or floating elements, use backdrop-blur-xl with bg-[#12182b]/70 and a 1px border of white/10. NEVER use transparent backgrounds directly.
visual_enhancers.gradients: No massive gradients. Use subtle radial gradients at the top of the screen or inside specific cards to simulate 'glow' from the data (e.g., small cyan radial glow).
visual_enhancers.animations: Subtle pulse animations for active workloads. Scanner lines or moving gradients in the border for high-value cards.

grids_and_layouts.dashboard_grid: High Density Grid (grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-3 lg:grid-cols-4) with gap-4 or gap-6. Every pixel utilized.
grids_and_layouts.spacing: Generous Spacing (p-6, p-8) inside containers with borders to prevent text collision. Mobile-first responsive grids.
grids_and_layouts.alignment: Data and forms strictly left-aligned. Values in tables right-aligned if numeric, left if text.

components.cards: Cardless, rectangular, sharp-edged or max 4px radius. 1px solid borders.
components.buttons: Sharp buttons, hover states with text color change and border glow.
components.badges: For Workload Status (Secure, Processing, Completed, Failed): Use JetBrains Mono, uppercase, highly visible neon colors with a 10% opacity background of the same color.
components.tables: Shadcn tables with dense spacing, strict left alignment, and distinct hover state on rows.
components.forms: Shadcn forms, solid background inputs, 1px border focus state.

hero_background.description: Server rack neon blue. Use with heavy dark overlay (e.g., bg-black/70) for background sections or banners.

confidential_computing_explanation.description: Combination lock. Use for the educational section explaining Confidential Computing.

tee_technologies.description: CPU chip macro. Use for TEE Technologies (Intel SGX/AMD SEV) feature cards.

motion.hover_states: All interactive elements must shift visually. Text color must lighten/darken, borders must glow.
motion.loading: Use code-like loading states (e.g., ASCII spinners or typing text) rather than generic circles.
motion.transitions: Use specific transition properties like `transition: transform 0.2s ease, opacity 0.2s ease`. NO `transition-all`.

accessibility.contrast: Ensure minimum 4.5:1 ratio. Neon text must be bright enough against the deep navy background.
accessibility.focus: Focus states must have a 2px outline in neon cyan (ring-cyan-400) or primary color.
accessibility.testing: All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a `data-testid` attribute (e.g., data-testid='submit-workload-btn').

3d_libraries_and_charts.charts: Use Recharts for the Security Analysis indicators. A Radar Chart is highly recommended for displaying Data Protection, Memory Isolation, Runtime Protection, Secure Execution, and Attestation metrics.

instructions_to_main_agent: Do not use generic centering for the app container (.App { text-align: center; } is FORBIDDEN).
Use 1px borders to separate dashboard modules. No heavy box shadows in dark mode.
Pre-populate 3-5 sample workloads in MongoDB for demo purposes.
Build a custom Workload Monitoring table with 'Secure', 'Processing', 'Completed', 'Failed' statuses.
For TEE Technologies comparison, use a grid of high-contrast cards.
Include a CI/CD Pipeline Status card showing GitHub and Jenkins build statuses.
Ensure the dashboard conveys a 'Security/DevOps SaaS' aesthetic.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: Avoid generic outputs, 'AI slop' aesthetic, or simplistic gradients. Create depth with z-index hierarchy and glassmorphism. Never apply universal transitions (transition-all). Use 2-3x more spacing than typical. Incorporate micro-animations. Ensure all interactive components have a `data-testid` attribute. ONLY use images from the provided image_urls. Do not use placeholders.
